summary: Counts new window state objects: a repeated, unchanged agent-status, crew, usage or quiet event makes none after the first (putIfChanged, wired into useAgentStatus), and 10 panes animating a title spinner hand the window no identity while it turns and one when it stops (identityPacer).

tests.name: LAG-02: a repeated, unchanged status event makes no new state > putIfChanged gives back the same object when nothing changed, a new one for a real change
LAG-02: a repeated, unchanged status event makes no new state > the same agent-status payload 50 times makes one change
LAG-02: a repeated, unchanged status event makes no new state > 10 panes sending unchanged status for 200 ticks make 10 changes, none after the first
LAG-02: a repeated, unchanged status event makes no new state > the agent-status, usage and quiet listeners go through putIfChanged
LAG-02: title frames of an animating agent stay out of the window > 10 panes animating a spinner for 10 seconds hand the window one title each, after the spinner stops
LAG-02: title frames of an animating agent stay out of the window > 10 panes repeating the same title for 100 ticks hand the window nothing after the agent appears
